title: 2008 HMMT February Team Round 2 Problem 2
statement: (Freshman's Dream) Let \(z^{n}\) denote \(z \odot z \odot z \odot \cdots \odot z\) with \(z\) appearing \(n\) times. Prove that \((x \oplus y)^{n}=x^{n} \oplus y^{n}\) for all \(x, y \in \mathbb{R} \cup\{\infty\}\) and positive integer \(n\).

solutions.text: Without loss of generality, suppose that \(x \leq y\), then \(L H S=\min (x, y)^{n}=x^{n}=\) \(n x\), and RHS \(=\min \left(x^{n}, y^{n}\right)=\min (n x, n y)=n x\).
